pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(soft piano intro, quiet midnight atmosphere)

[Verse 1]
Like a scene from a gentle film
I thought goodbye might look that way
But you passed through like sudden rain
leaving silence in your wake

In a quiet corner of the night
I wonder if it was only me
loving a shadow in the room
while the world moved quietly

[Chorus]
Unspoken words still drift inside
like breath fading in the air
I hold them close within the dark
a whisper no one hears

The night listens patiently
while my thoughts return again
calling your name softly
in an empty room

[Verse 2]
Moments I cannot return to
rise like waves against the shore
I stand inside abandoned time
looking back once more

If that day had only passed
like strangers in the street
perhaps this heart would never learn
how deep the silence can be

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo, reflective atmosphere)

[Bridge]
Even when I try to let it go
warmth returns to my hands
I know nothing will come back
yet memory quietly stands

A feeling words cannot explain
rests inside this restless night
I sit beside the quiet window
holding fading light

[Chorus]
Unspoken words still drift inside
like breath fading in the air
Though you will never hear them now
they linger somewhere

To the heart that left in fragments
far beyond my reach
one small voice still whispers
what I could not speak

[Outro]
(soft piano outro, calm and reflective)

It was love to me
even in the silence
even in the dark
